description: This file contains data access helper functions for a financial dashboard application. It includes functions for fetching transaction summaries, recent transactions, paginated transaction data, insights, alerts, and related utilities, all interacting with a Supabase backend. It emphasizes user-scoped, safe, RLS-friendly data retrieval, currency normalization, and USD conversion via external FX rate services.

methods.name: toNumberOrNull(value)
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a finite number or returns null if not finite.

methods.name: normalizeCurrency(value)
methods.description: Normalizes currency codes to uppercase 3-letter strings, defaulting to 'USD'.

methods.name: escapeForILike(input)
methods.description: Escapes input string for safe use in ilike search queries.

methods.name: buildOccurredAtBounds(dateRange)
methods.description: Creates ISO date bounds from a date range object with 'from' and 'to' properties.

methods.name: getMonthBounds(reference = new Date())
methods.description: Returns ISO bounds for the current month.

methods.name: sumAmounts(rows)
methods.description: Sums an array of rows' 'amount' fields, normalizing to numbers.

methods.name: sumAmountsUSD(rows, rates)
methods.description: Sums transaction amounts converted to USD using provided FX rates.

methods.name: deriveTrendPercent(value)
methods.description: Estimates a UI trend percentage based on a spending value.

methods.name: getUserContext({ userId, allowDemoUser = true } = {})
methods.description: Returns a user context object with userId and demo flag, defaulting to a demo user if none provided.

methods.name: requireSupabase()
methods.description: Ensures that the 'supabase' client is configured, throwing an error otherwise.

methods.name: getRatesForConversion()
methods.description: Fetches FX rates for currency conversion, caching within the call.

methods.name: fetchDashboardSummaryFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true } = {})
methods.description: Fetches monthly KPI summary from transactions, normalized to USD, including spend, savings, and budget estimates.

methods.name: fetchRecentTransactionsFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, limit = 5 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches latest transactions with their USD equivalents, limited by count.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsPageFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, page = 1, pageSize = 15, filters = {} } = {})
methods.description: Provides paginated transaction data with filters for date, category, amount, and search, including USD-normalized amounts.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsSummaryFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, filters = {} } = {})
methods.description: Returns summarized totals and averages for filtered transaction data.

methods.name: fetchInsightsSummaryFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, timeRange = "30d", segment = "Category" } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a high-level insights summary for a selected time range, returning totals and a trend percent.

methods.name: fetchAlertsFromSupabase({ userId, allowDemoUser = true, status = "all", severity = "all", limit = 25 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves alerts with optional status and severity filters, ordered by recent updates.
